description: This file contains a series of tests to validate the behavior and robustness of Git submodule configurations, URL checks, symlink handling, and related repository integrity checks. It utilizes shell scripting and Git commands to perform setup, execution, and verification steps for different scenarios involving submodules, symlinks, and repository states.

methods.name: check_dotx_symlink
methods.description: Sets up repositories with symlinked Git attributes files and verifies that the Git fsck detects symlinked files preventing invalid states.
